# WEBAPPZZ TECHNOLOGIES

> Independent digital studio in Cheruthuruthi, Kerala, India. WEBAPPZZ designs and develops business websites, web applications, Flutter products, confidential in-house billing and business software, SEO, Google Business Profile improvements, and digital marketing systems.
